summary: BA spec for §5.11 is substantially accurate. The primary evidence at SidebarFileView.tsx:49 is verified exactly as claimed (unconstrained Text, styles.filePath lines 213-218 with no flexShrink/numberOfLines/maxWidth). CodexPatchView.tsx:119 is also confirmed as a second render site. The grep scope investigation is complete — only these two files render filePath as a visible Text element. One notable caveat: BA characterized CodexPatchView's styles.filePath as having 'same unguarded style' as SidebarFileView, but it actually already has flex:1 (lines 158-163), making the two sites structurally different though both benefit from the same fix. This is a minor inaccuracy that does not change the fix prescription but should be noted to Dev.

evidence.claim: SidebarFileView.tsx:49 renders filePath as unconstrained Text with no numberOfLines, flexShrink, or maxWidth; styles.filePath (lines 213-218) has only cosmetic props
evidence.verification: Read file directly. Line 49 verbatim: '<Text style={styles.filePath}>{filePath.replace(/\//g, "/\u200B")}</Text>'. styles.filePath at lines 213-218: {fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '600', color: theme.colors.textSecondary, marginBottom: 8}. No flexShrink, no numberOfLines, no ellipsizeMode, no maxWidth, no overflow properties. Enclosing ScrollView (line 47) has only contentContainerStyle with padding, no width constraint.

scope.claim: CodexPatchView.tsx:119 also renders filePath with the same unguarded style
scope.verification: Line 119 verbatim: '<Text style={styles.filePath}>{filePath}</Text>'. Correct render site. HOWEVER, styles.filePath for CodexPatchView (lines 158-163) is: {fontSize: 13, color: theme.colors.text, fontFamily: 'monospace', flex: 1}. Note flex:1 — this IS a width constraint when inside the fileHeaderMain flexDirection:'row' container. BA spec at line 39 and line 117 calls it 'same unguarded style' and 'unguarded style' which is technically inaccurate.
scope.caveat: The fix (adding numberOfLines={1} + ellipsizeMode='middle') is still correct for this site because flex:1 alone does not truncate overflowing text — it only allocates width from the parent. Text with intrinsic width > allocated still overflows visibly on web RN. Dev should NOT add flexShrink:1 to CodexPatchView styles.filePath (already has flex:1 which serves the same purpose in this flex-row context). Adding numberOfLines={1} + ellipsizeMode='middle' is sufficient for CodexPatchView.

investigation.claim: BA grepped for file_path to find all render sites in packages/happy-app/sources/components/
investigation.verification: Independently ran Grep for 'file_path|filePath' in packages/happy-app/sources/components/. Results: 6 files match — SidebarFileView.tsx, CodexPatchView.tsx, GeminiEditView.tsx, knownTools.tsx, suggestions.ts, AgentInputSuggestionView.tsx. Of these, only SidebarFileView.tsx:49 and CodexPatchView.tsx:119 are actual Text render sites with a filePath style. Others: knownTools.tsx uses file_path in Zod schemas and resolvePath() calls (no rendering), GeminiEditView.tsx extracts path from input but renders only through ToolDiffView (no filePath Text), suggestions.ts/AgentInputSuggestionView.tsx handle autocomplete (not detail panel). Ran secondary Grep for 'styles\.filePath' — returned ONLY the 2 sites BA identified. Scope is complete and correct.

objections.location: ba-spec-20260424-143000-8.md:39,117; context JSON evidence.observations[4] and scope_expansion
objections.finding: BA describes CodexPatchView's styles.filePath as 'same unguarded style' and claims it has 'identical pattern' to SidebarFileView. In reality, CodexPatchView's styles.filePath (lines 158-163) already has flex:1, which is a width allocation constraint inside its flex-row parent. SidebarFileView has NO width constraint at all (neither flex nor flexShrink). The two sites have the same symptom (unbounded Text width → horizontal overflow without numberOfLines) but structurally different baselines.
objections.impact_on_fix: Low. The prescribed fix (numberOfLines={1} + ellipsizeMode='middle') still applies correctly to both sites. However, BA's Fix pattern in Technical Hints says to add flexShrink:1 to both — for CodexPatchView, Dev should NOT add flexShrink:1 (conflicts with existing flex:1; one is sufficient, dual is redundant). BA should have noted: SidebarFileView needs flexShrink:1 ADDED; CodexPatchView already has flex:1 and only needs numberOfLines/ellipsizeMode props on the Text.
objections.recommendation: Add a note to Dev: for CodexPatchView, only apply numberOfLines={1} + ellipsizeMode='middle' to the Text at line 119. Do not add flexShrink:1 to styles.filePath since flex:1 already constrains width within the flex-row container.

objections.finding: BA recommends removing the U+200B zero-width space replacement when switching to single-line ellipsis. This is correct advice (zero-width spaces interfere with clipboard copy and provide no benefit under single-line clamp), but Dev should verify that no screen reader or copy-raw-path test depends on the current behavior. Low risk.
objections.impact_on_fix: None. Confirms BA's judgment is sound.
objections.recommendation: Proceed with U+200B removal as BA suggests; the Text becomes {filePath} directly.

objections.finding: R2/AC2 require full path to remain accessible via 'tooltip, long-press copy, or tap-to-expand (any one acceptable)'. BA marks the copy-to-clipboard affordance as Should Have (R5) rather than Must Have. But then R2 is Must Have — if Dev skips the clipboard copy, how is the full path accessible? A tooltip on web via the `title` prop is the simplest path, but React Native Text doesn't support `title` natively on web without a web-specific wrapper. Dev must pick ONE affordance and BA has not firmly directed which.
objections.impact_on_fix: Medium. Dev could implement middle-ellipsis truncation (satisfies R1) but then fail R2 if no copy/tooltip/tap affordance is added. QA verification should explicitly test that the full path is retrievable via at least one user action.
objections.recommendation: Dev should at minimum add Pressable + expo-clipboard onPress (5-10 LOC). Without this, R2 fails even if R1 passes.

attempts_to_disprove_ba: Verified line numbers by directly reading both files — confirmed exact
Independently grepped for file_path|filePath to check BA missed no render sites — confirmed only 2 sites
Independently grepped for styles\.filePath — returned exactly the 2 sites BA identified
Checked GeminiEditView.tsx for unconstrained path rendering — none found (path goes through ToolDiffView, not direct Text)
Compared styles.filePath between the two files — discovered structural difference (CodexPatchView has flex:1, SidebarFileView has nothing)
Checked for numberOfLines/ellipsizeMode elsewhere in sidebar/ directory — none present (genuine absence, not a gap BA missed)

pass_fail_decision.rationale: BA evidence is accurate, file locations verified, scope investigation complete. Only caveat is a minor mischaracterization of CodexPatchView's existing flex:1 that does not invalidate the fix approach but does require a small adjustment in the Technical Hints (don't add flexShrink:1 to CodexPatchView). The R2 accessibility question is a Should-Have ambiguity that Dev/QA must resolve during implementation and verification.
pass_fail_decision.notes_for_dev: (1) SidebarFileView: add numberOfLines={1} + ellipsizeMode='middle' to Text at line 49; add flexShrink:1 to styles.filePath; remove U+200B replacement. (2) CodexPatchView: add numberOfLines={1} + ellipsizeMode='middle' to Text at line 119; DO NOT add flexShrink:1 (flex:1 is already present and sufficient). (3) To satisfy R2 (MUST HAVE), wrap the filePath Text in a Pressable + expo-clipboard onPress in SidebarFileView — without this the full path is inaccessible after truncation.
